result.quote: So the old prophet lifted up the body of the man of God, laid it on the donkey, and brought it back to his own city to mourn for him and bury him.
result.reason: The key is supported: the old prophet buries the man in his own tomb. However, the broad question also permits several other actions, including lifting the body, placing it on the donkey, bringing it to the city, and laying it in the tomb. The wording should specify that it is asking where he laid or buried the body.
